text:
Samira: Heads-up — RapidProof trial kickoff next Mon (May 2). I sketched a fast timeline and need owners/confirmations:
- Week 0 (this week): infra prep + IP allowlist
- Week 1: integration + smoke tests
- Week 2: UAT with their product team
- Week 3: metrics handoff + success criteria check

Owners I'm proposing: network/VPC peering -> Priya; API contract -> Rajesh; staging infra -> Marta; E2E + alerts -> Luca. Please confirm or reassign. Any blockers?

Priya Patel: I can take network/VPC peering. Need RapidProof's egress IPs and the list of hosts for allowlisting. Can we get the IPs by EOD Thu? Planning maintenance window Tue 10:00–11:00 PST for peering so it doesn't collide with customer demos.

Rajesh Nair: Confirmed for API contract. Quick question — do we expose streaming responses for the POC or use polling? Their client mentioned low-latency chat. Streaming is fine from infra side but we should pin a model variant to keep perf predictable. I'll draft an API spec by Thu.

Marta Velez: Staging infra almost ready. Need a service account (secrets+SA) for RapidProof CI and an SSH jump host access list. I can run smoke tests on Wed after Priya's peering. If peering slips, smoke will slide to Thu.

Luca Bianchi: I'll own E2E integration tests and monitoring. Plan: add a per-route latency SLO dashboard and two alerts (p50 > 500ms for 5m, error rate > 1% for 5m). I'll add the dashboard to the trial workspace and share links.

Samira: Thanks — sounds good. Two quick clarifications: (1) Success criteria for SE to sign off: 95% of sample prompts under 800ms p95 and zero critical functional regressions on our eval set; (2) Data flow: no customer data persisted outside the trial workspace; make sure logs are redacted.

Rajesh Nair: Noted on success criteria. For streaming: we'll default to streaming for chat endpoints; fallback polling for legacy clients. API spec will include both. Also we'll pin the model to "rlft-v1.2-quant" for cost predictability.

Priya Patel: I'll request IP list from their infra contact (sherif@rapidproof.com) and post it here when received. Maintenance window Tue 10–11 PST is good for me.

Marta Velez: Service account request: please add rapidproof-ci@redwood-trials to the IAM with minimal roles: run-jobs, read-artifacts. Rajesh, can you include the callback URL for webhooks in the spec?

Rajesh Nair: Yep — will include webhook/callback examples and auth headers in the spec draft.

deploy-bot: Staging workspace created: rp-rapidproof-staging (env id: env-rp-2212). Run `rwctl status env-rp-2212` to check.

Luca Bianchi: I'll start a skeleton E2E job against rp-rapidproof-staging once Marta confirms SA and Priya confirms peering.

Samira: Great — if we can close priya/ip, marta/sa, rajesh/spec by Thu EOD, we should hit the Mon kickoff. Please add any additional blockers here. :thumbsup:

Priya Patel: Will update here when I have the IPs.

Marta Velez: Filing the SA request now.

Rajesh Nair: Spec draft by Thu AM, pinging for review.

Luca Bianchi: Adding dashboard + alert PR, will request reviews.

Samira: Thanks all — tagging the customer-facing SEs to keep them in the loop: @Priya, @Rajesh, @Luca.
